title: Solar Plant Manager
description: Solar Plant Manager Caribbean HR Solutions Clarendon / Kingston and St. Andrew / St. Catherine Not disclosed Contract Updated 20/11/2026 Senior Executive Recruiter Log in or register to apply Share Share this job Facebook Twitter Report This Job Save Save Caribbean HR Solutions is the Caribbean's premier HR Outsourcing Company specializing in Executive Search, Recruiting, HRO, and Payroll services on behalf of our client, SOL Jamaica, we solicit candidates to apply for the role of Solar Plant Manager. Job Scope As the Solar Plant Manager, you will provide overall leadership and single-point accountability for the safe, reliable, compliant and cost-effective operation and maintenance of the Solar 20 MWac solar PV plant. You will serve as the key in-country representative with local government and permitting authorities and the local community. The Solar Plant Manager will also m aximize plant availability and energy production while meeting all obligations under the Power Purchase Agreement with JPS, the O&M and related agreements, the Generation Licence and applicable Jamaican law. Core Functions and Responsibilities Manage and ensure compliance with the O&M Agreement and related agreements. Supervise, schedule, manage, and develop the O&M technician team. Ensure O&M monthly and annual reports are completed and delivered to stakeholders on time Develop, manage, and own the Annual Maintenance Plan and Site Operating Plan, ensuring preventive, corrective, and unscheduled maintenance is performed across the plant, substation, and O&M Building. Oversee SCADA-based monitoring, alarm response, and CMMS/work-order management. Troubleshoot and assist in rectifying technical and operational issues. Supervise and manage spare parts acquisition, inventory levels, and inventory control. Review, track, and report production and performance data and key performance indicators (KPIs), including availability, energy output and performance ratio. Serve as primary operational liaison with JPS. Provide single-point accountability for the achievement of reliability, safety, and budget objectives. Scope, tender, contract, supervise, and manage the budget and performance of third-party contractors for specialized work. Serve as site HSE lead, managing PPE, safety protocols, and compliance with applicable environmental, health, and safety obligations, in line with Sol Ecolution’s HSE standards. Coordinate with JPS and other stakeholders to prepare HSE and emergency protocols, including the Hurricane Preparedness Plan and others as needed. Participate in or lead project committee meetings as needed (e.g., annual Hurricane Preparedness Plan, maintenance planning). Manage official performance communications in collaboration with Sol Ecolution management. Perform other related duties aligned with the level and scope of the role as assigned Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (preferred) or related engineering discipline; registration as a Professional Engineer in Jamaica is an asset. Minimum ten (10) years of relevant experience in power generation, utility or solar PV operations and maintenance, including at least three (3) years in a supervisory or plant/site management role. Hands-on knowledge of utility-scale PV systems, inverters, MV/HV substations, transformers and protection systems. Experience with SCADA monitoring and CMMS/work-order systems (e.g., GPM SCADA or similar). Proven experience managing O&M contracts, contractors and subcontractors, including tendering, budgeting and performance management. Strong HSE background; recognize safety certification (e.g., NEBOSH, OSHA or equivalent) is preferred. Working knowledge of the Jamaican electricity sector and regulatory framework, including JPS, the OUR, generation licensing, and interconnection and PPA obligations. Experience with hurricane preparedness and emergency response planning is an asset. Familiarity with PV performance analysis tools (e.g., PVsyst) and KPI reporting is a plus. Excellent problem-solving, analytical and troubleshooting skills in an operational context. Exceptionally high level of focus on quality of work and attention to detail. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Valid Jamaican Driver’s license. Though we appreciate all applicants, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
